result.rationale: The December 2024 take-private and current ownership are directly supported, but Atlantica remains a global sustainable-infrastructure platform rather than a manager-level company primarily based in or dedicated to North America. Although North America represents roughly 61-62% of power-generation capacity, the company continues to own and develop material businesses across Europe and South America, is headquartered in London, and presents itself as a global multi-region platform.

operatingResolution.northAmericaTest: Latest corporate presentation shows approximately 61% of operating renewable capacity (62% including projects in operation/construction) in North America, but the company continues to operate diversified businesses across Europe and South America and markets itself as a global platform rather than a North America-dedicated platform.
operatingResolution.contractModel: Long-term contracted infrastructure assets with development, financing, construction and operating capabilities.

acquisitionExitCheck.2024TakePrivate: Announced 2024-05-27 at US$22/share; High Court sanctioned scheme 2024-12-10; legally completed 2024-12-12.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterChanges: No evidence through 2026-08-19 of an ECP or Temasek exit or recapitalization changing ultimate ownership; company instead expanded through North American development and Canadian renewable acquisitions.
